What is MiraiLink and how does it work?
MiraiLink is a social and dating app designed for anime, manga, and gaming enthusiasts. We connect you with like-minded people based on shared cultural interests and geographic proximity.
What is Haptic Heartbeat and how does sensory feedback work?

Haptic Heartbeat is an immersive tactile experience. Holding down on a photo or swiping a profile card triggers real-time heartbeat vibrations synchronized with your mutual anime, gaming, and relationship affinities.
How does MiraiLink calculate affinity between profiles?
The system compares your selected anime, games, and relationship goals with those of other users, highlighting your shared interests to spark natural conversations.
How do profile cards and gestures work?
Swipe right to like someone, or swipe left to pass. You can also tap any card to open the full detailed profile view with all photos, bio, and gaming prompts.
What is the Explore tab and how do category feeds work?
In Explore, you can browse dedicated categories (such as Cosplay, eSports, Shonen, J-RPG, or Retro Anime) to find people sharing your specific niche interests beyond distance-only sorting.
What happens if I run out of profiles to swipe?

If you have reviewed all nearby profiles, you can expand your age range or search distance in Search Preferences. Upgrading to MiraiLink Plus or Premium unlocks up to 250 km radius or worldwide Passport Mode.
How does a Match happen and when can I chat?
A Match occurs instantly when two people like each other. A private real-time chat room is created immediately via WebSockets with live notifications.
How is my location handled and why are up to 50 points saved?

To calculate distance to other users and enable future features like reunions or visited places, we keep a history of up to the last 50 points where you used the app. A new position is only recorded if you moved more than 5 km or after 24 hours. Once 50 points are exceeded, the oldest ones are automatically removed. Your exact location is never visible to other users.
What is the difference between place of residence and current location?

Your place of residence is the city shown on your profile (\"Lives in Palma\"). By default, searches compare residence locations. If you enable the travelers option, the app will match users who are physically within your radius right now even if they reside elsewhere.
Can other users see my exact address or GPS coordinates?
No, never. For your safety and privacy, MiraiLink never shares GPS coordinates or street addresses. Only approximate distance in kilometers or your home city is displayed.
What subscription tiers are available and what perks do they offer?

MiraiLink offers three tiers: Free (basic search, matching, and unlimited messaging), MiraiLink Plus (ad-free experience, up to 250 km distance radius, unlimited likes, and Plus badge), and MiraiLink Premium (all Plus benefits, worldwide Passport Mode, see who liked you with direct matching, and Gold badge).
How does billing and renewal work?
All transactions are processed securely through Google Play Billing. You can select weekly, monthly, or 3-month plans with auto-renewal, which can be managed or canceled at any time.
How can I cancel my active subscription?
You can cancel anytime via Google Play Store > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, or via Manage Subscription in Settings. You retain all benefits until the end of your billing period.
How do I restore my purchases on a new phone?
Open the subscription screen while signed into the same Google Play account and tap Restore purchases to instantly re-enable your membership.
What features are included in the Premium model?
MiraiLink Premium unlocks worldwide Passport Mode without borders, see who liked you with instant matching, expanded search filters, zero ads, and the exclusive Gold profile badge.
What is Mirai Studio and photo quality analysis?
It is a computer vision tool integrated into photo selection. Running on-device AI (100% private), it evaluates lighting, framing, sharpness, and thirds composition to ensure great profile pictures.
Can I upload cosplay, anime, or full-body photos?
Yes! If your photo is a full cosplay, an avatar, or an illustration representing you, Mirai Studio automatically applies General Visual Quality mode without requiring a standard face.
What are the recommended photo quality standards?
We recommend clear photos with good front or natural light (avoiding heavy shadows or extreme backlighting), minimum 720p resolution, and focused subjects.
Screenshots frequently include status bars, battery icons, or black bars that degrade your profile card. Cropping or using original image downloads is recommended.
Why can\'t I change my username?
Your username is your unique profile handle and forms your permanent direct profile link. To prevent impersonation and maintain community integrity, usernames cannot be modified after registration.
2FA provides extra security using time-based one-time codes (TOTP) from apps like Google Authenticator. You can enable or disable it anytime in Settings > Configure Two-Factor Authentication.
How do I delete my account and what happens to my data?
You can permanently delete your account in Settings > Delete Account. This immediately removes your profile, photos, location history, matches, and chats irreversibly.
